summary: This 8-K reports a routine registered or exempt equity issuance by Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund under Item 3.02 (unregistered sales), along with voluntary portfolio disclosures under Item 7.01. The fund issued ~1.75M common shares at $24.79/share for aggregate proceeds of ~$43.4M, relying on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D accredited-investor exemptions. No special-situation change of control, restructuring, tender, or activist event is described. The portfolio update for March 2026 shows standard BDC metrics. This is ordinary-course capital raising and periodic disclosure, not a special situation.
